visual_action: A montage of clips from a large outdoor protest in Washington D.C., with the Washington Monument visible in the background. Crowds of people are shown holding various handmade protest signs.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Overlay text states: "All across the country, Americans are protesting Trump and Musk".

cast.name: Elon Musk
cast.evidence: Overlay text states: "All across the country, Americans are protesting Trump and Musk".

on_screen_text.text: All across the country, Americans are protesting Trump and Musk
HANDS OFF the SOUL of our Nation We ARE GOOD, DECENT & GENEROUS people We will NOT be destroyed by YOUR PETTINESS & GREED
TREASON IS THE REASON FOR IMPEACHMENT
invest in our SCHOOLS ~ not ~ Tax Cuts for billionaires

spoken_summary: The audio does not contain spoken dialogue but instead features lyrics from the song "LABOUR (the cacophony)" by Paris Paloma, including the line "It's not an act of love, if you make her, you make me do too much labor."
audio_music: An anthemic, female-led pop song with a strong, driving beat plays throughout the montage. The music has a powerful and defiant tone, creating a feeling of empowerment and solidarity appropriate for a protest video.
editing_pacing: A quick-cut montage showing various scenes and different people at a protest.
cultural_references: The song 'LABOUR (the cacophony)' by Paris Paloma, which went viral on TikTok and is often used as a feminist and protest anthem.
central_claim: A large and diverse movement of Americans is actively protesting against the influence and actions of Donald Trump and Elon Musk.
intended_effect: To energize supporters by showcasing widespread opposition to Trump and Musk and to encourage solidarity with the protest movement.
